summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the voluntary transfer of its U.S. stock exchange listing from the NYSE American to the Nasdaq Global Select Market, under the same symbol CNL. The last trading day on NYSE American is expected August 10, 2026, with Nasdaq trading starting August 11, 2026. The TSX listing and CUSIP remain unchanged. The move is intended to enhance visibility and broaden investor access. No new offering or financing is involved, and no shareholder action is required. This is a routine exchange listing transfer, not a special situation.
